Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(5, 18, 32)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

__
 
• **2nd number = (1st number × 4) - 2**
 
• **3rd number = (2ⁿd number × 2) - 4**

(5, 18, 32)

 
• 2nd number = 5 × 4 - 2 = 20 - 2 = 18 
 
• 3rd number = 18 × 2 - 4 = 36 - 4 = 32 

Similarly, 

**Option 4: (9, 34, 64)**

 
• **2nd number = 9 × 4 - 2 = 36 - 2 = 34**
 
• **3rd number = 34 × 2 - 4 = 68 - 4 = 64 **

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__**

__**First method:**__

**(Middle number x 4) - (First number x 8) = third number**

(5, 18, 32) 

__
 
• (18 x 4) - (5 x 8) = 72 - 40 = 32

Similarly, 

**Option 4: (9, 34, 64)**

 
• **(34 x 4) - (9 x 8) = 136 - 72 = 64**

**Second method:**__

The logic followed here is;

**(First Number × 3) + (First Number - 2) = Second Number**

**(Second Number × 2) - 4 = Third Number**

In (5, 18, 32);

 
• (5 × 3) + (5 - 2) 
 
• = 15 + 3 = 18
 
• (18 × 2) - 4 
 
• = 36 - 4

= 32

Similarly;

In (9, 34, 64);

 
• (9 × 3) + (9 - 2)
 
• = 27 + 7 = 34
 
• (34 × 2) - 4
 
• = 68 - 4
 
• = 64

Hence, **"(9, 34, 64)"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: There are 14 people in a joint family and the average age of all the family members is 30 years. Now, a baby boy is born in that family. After 4 years, what will be the average age of all the family members?
questions.solution:
Let, the sum of age of 14 people = x years

Average of 14 people = x/14

According to question;

x/14 = 30 years

x = 420 years

After 4 years;

Baby age = 4 years

So, the sum of age of 15 people after 4 years = 420 + (15 × 4)

= 420 + 60 = 480 years

Now, 

The average of 15 people including baby = 480/15

= 32 years

Hence, **The average age of family members after 4 years is "32 years".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, Il, Ill, IV. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All students are experts.

2. Some experts are tutors.

3. All tutors are Indians.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Indians are experts.

Il. Some Indians are students.

lll. No Indian is a student.

IV. All tutors are experts.

options.text: Only conclusions IV, and either II or III follow
Only conclusions I, and either II or III follow
Only conclusions I, II and IV follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f8a58ce403ebcde34b89c8b7002a6debc28ee9bdaa7cd21b929fa33869a1c06.png] 

I. Some Indians are experts → True (As Some experts are tutors and All tutors are Indians. So, Some Indians are experts)

Il. Some Indians are students → False (There is no direct relation between Indians and students)

lll. No Indian is a student → False (There is no direct relation between Indians and students)

IV. All tutors are experts → False (As Some experts are tutors. So this is the possibility not definite)

Conclusion II and III are complementary to each other.

Hence, **Only conclusions I, and either II or III follow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7a57a894c18035669909fbf9c4354c0c1b1190c15322110f6b29c9a2b52e076.png] 

Either and or conditions:

1. One conclusion is positive and one is negative.

2. The elements are the same in both the conclusions.

3. Individually both conclusions must be wrong.

questions.question: If 12 May 2011 was a Thursday, then what was the day of the week on 10 May 2004?
questions.solution:
12 May 2011 = Thursday

Number of years between 2004 and 2011 = 7 

Number of leap years between 2004 and 2011 = 1

So, total number of odd days = (7 + 1)/7 = 8/7 = 1 (remainder)

As, 12 may 2011 = Thursday

So, 12 May 2004 = Wednesday (Decrease 1 day as 1 odd day)

So, 10 May 2004 = Monday

Hence, **"Monday"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a class of 140 students, 16 students do not participate in any of the quiz and Ashu competitions. 70 students participate in the quiz and 77 students take part in the Ashu competition. How many students participate in both the quiz and Ashu competition activities?
questions.solution:
Total student = 140

Students do not take part in any of the quiz and Ashu competitions = 16

Students who take part in Quiz and Ashu completion n(U) = 140 - 16 = 124

Students take part in Quiz n(Q) = 70

Students take part in Ashu competitions n(A) = 77

Students participate in both the quiz and Ashu competition = n(Q U A)

Now; 

n(QUA) = n(Q) + n(A) - n(Q∩A)

124 = 70 + 77 - (Q∩A)

(Q∩A) = 147 - 124

(Q∩A) = 23

Hence, **Students participate in both the quiz and Ashu competition is 23.**

4

 
 
 
3

 
 
 
18

 
 
 

 
 
5

 
 
 
6

 
 
 
27

 
 
 

 
 
7

 
 
 
3

 
 
 
?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is;

**In Row 1:**

(4 × 3) + 6

= 18

**In Row 2:**

(5 × 6) - 3

= 27

**In Row 3:**

(7 × 3) + 6

= 27

Hence, **"27"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****__LOGIC__:** In a Row wise:

**(First Number × 3) + (Second Number × 2) = Third Number**

**In Row 1:**

(4 × 3) + (3 × 2) 

= 12 + 6

= 18

**In Row 2:**

(5 × 3) + (6 × 2)

= 15 + 12

= 27

**In Row 3:**

(7 × 3) + (3 × 2)

= 21 + 6

= 27

Hence, "27" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

__LOGIC__: In a Column wise:

(Second Number + Third Number) **÷ 3 = First Number **

In Column 1:

(5 + 7) ÷ 3 

= 12 ÷ 3

= 4

In Column 2:

(6 + 3) ÷ 3

= 9 ÷ 3

= 3

In Column 3:

(27 + x) ÷ 3 = 18

⇒ (27 + x) = 18 × 3

⇒ 27 + x = 54

⇒ x = 54 - 27

⇒ x = 27

Hence, "27" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

4 ∶ 128 ∶∶ 6 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is;

In 4 ∶ 128 →

4 × (4 × 8)

= 4 × 32

= 128

In 6 ∶ ? →

6 × (6 × 12)

= 6 × 72 

= 432

Hence, **"432"** is the correct answer.
